name: Futaba (Yamanashi, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Futaba town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised character above two leaves.
history: Flag of the former town of Futaba in Yamanashi Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-09-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 March 1955.

features.role: Futaba town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised character above two leaves
